review.reviewNotes: Eight distinct complete Nova Stitch steal poses preserve the teal high ponytail, face, human anatomy and teal/purple kit. Pose3 reaches at tick5; pose4 pulls the ball-miming hand back, then she pivots to escape. No ball is baked into the sprite art.

ballPolicy: Separate Nova-specific basketball is intercepted at pose3/tick5 and carried away after the steal. It is not painted into the poses.
